sections.content: The canonical specification defines VDD and Quick Dev semantic verification with independent execution, real process evidence, target and fixture binding, exact sound-and-complete many-to-many Acceptance ID coverage, and publication of an external recovery artifact.
sections.title: Specification

sections.content: Normative requirements cover semantic verification contracts, preflight lanes, frozen execution descriptors, independent judging, non-zero execution, layered evidence and outcomes, deterministic failure identities, selective reuse and invalidation, self-hosted predecessor validation, false-green regressions, profiles, recovery, and completion gating.
sections.title: Requirements

sections.content: The package preserves provenance and adopted companion roles, separates evidence_state, verification_outcome, failure_family, and failure_id, and resolves artifact authority, evidence snapshots, identity construction, and promotion ownership. Comparator policy, judge lifecycle, rollback probes, unexpected-green proof, stop-loss thresholds, platform compatibility, and detailed reuse remain deferred.
